summary: API V3 - [PUT] /api/v3/events/{eventId}/sessions/types/{typeId} (Update session type)

ai.s: Adds a V3 PUT endpoint to update an existing session type by its internal ID.
ai.pr: In V2, session type updates were combined with creation in /api/v2/sessions/setType.
ai.wy: Part of the Public API V3 migration, splitting create and update into clear REST operations.
ai.oc: PUT /api/v3/events/{eventId}/sessions/types/{typeId} supports partial updates matched only by typeId.

summary: API V3 - [POST] /api/v3/events/{eventId}/sessions/tracks (Create session track)

ai.s: Adds a V3 POST endpoint to create session tracks as first-class entities that sessions can then reference.
ai.pr: In V2, /api/v2/sessions/setTrack handled both creating and updating tracks.
ai.wy: Part of the Public API V3 migration, splitting create and update into clear REST operations.
ai.oc: POST /api/v3/events/{eventId}/sessions/tracks creates a track that must exist before it is assigned to sessions.

summary: API V3 - [PUT] /api/v3/events/{eventId}/sessions/tracks/{trackId} (Update session track)

ai.s: Adds a V3 PUT endpoint to update an existing session track by its internal ID.
ai.pr: In V2, session track updates were combined with creation in /api/v2/sessions/setTrack.
ai.wy: Part of the Public API V3 migration, splitting create and update into clear REST operations.
ai.oc: PUT /api/v3/events/{eventId}/sessions/tracks/{trackId} supports partial updates matched only by trackId.

ai.oc: Embeddable workspace and SDK, CI/CD for models, code-defined data models for key EP entities with caching, and theming matched to the platform.

summary: Country Manager - Resolving duplicate city creation

ai.s: Stops duplicate cities in the Country Manager by limiting Add New City to TAMs and SuperAdmins and auto-filling city details from WikiData.
ai.pr: Clients created cities by typing all fields by hand, which led to duplicate city records.
ai.wy: Part of the Country Manager (Cities & Regions) clean-up; duplicates affect location data across the platform.
ai.oc: Add New City hidden for clients; a city-name dropdown auto-populates region, latitude, longitude and timezone from the WikiData integration.

summary: [Import] checkStatus uses deprecated synchronous XHR (async: false) — blocks UI

ai.s: Replaces the synchronous status check in the admin Import page with an async call so the UI no longer freezes.
ai.pr: checkStatus() used deprecated synchronous XHR, blocking the browser every 3 seconds during imports and blocking page load for all 7 import types.
ai.wy: Found during the code review for EP-52270 of the admin Import UI.
ai.oc: checkStatus refactored to async $.ajax with callbacks.

summary: [Import Participants] No loading indicator during readHeaders file parsing

ai.s: Adds a loading indicator while participant import files are parsed, so the page no longer looks frozen.
ai.pr: Between choosing a file and the column-mapping modal there was no spinner, so large files looked stuck and users re-clicked.
ai.wy: Found during the code review for EP-52270 of the admin Import UI.
ai.oc: A spinner shown when the readHeaders request starts and hidden on response.

summary: [Import] No client-side file size validation before upload

ai.s: Adds a client-side file size check before import uploads, warning users about oversized files.
ai.pr: Import only checked file type, so very large files were silently uploaded twice without warning.
ai.wy: Found during the code review for EP-52270 of the admin Import UI.
ai.oc: A size check before readHeaders with a warning above a threshold.

summary: [Import] "Cancel Upload" has no confirmation dialog — immediate destructive action

ai.s: Adds a confirmation dialog to "Cancel Upload" in the admin Import page to prevent accidental loss of queued tasks.
ai.pr: Cancel Upload immediately deleted all pending import tasks with no confirmation or recovery.
ai.wy: Found during the code review for EP-52270 of the admin Import UI.
ai.oc: A confirm dialog before the clearList request.

summary: [Import] Accessibility gaps — no ARIA attributes on progress bar, modals, file input

ai.s: Closes accessibility gaps in the admin Import UI with ARIA attributes and keyboard support.
ai.pr: The file input, progress bar, modals and tooltips lacked ARIA roles and keyboard access, so screen reader users could not use import, a WCAG 2.1 gap.
ai.wy: Found during the code review for EP-52270 of the admin Import UI.
ai.oc: ARIA attributes, keyboard navigation and role="log" on the upload log.

summary: [Import] File uploaded twice (readHeaders + importVisitors) — doubles upload time

ai.s: Stops the import flow uploading the same spreadsheet twice, halving upload time for large files.
ai.pr: The Excel file was uploaded once to read headers and again to import, doubling upload time.
ai.wy: Found during the code review for EP-52270 of the admin Import UI.
ai.oc: The file stored server-side after readHeaders and referenced by ID in importVisitors.

summary: Sent Emails export: add DB index and use CSV for large datasets

ai.s: Fixes Sent Emails exports failing on large events by adding a database index and switching big exports to streamed CSV.
ai.pr: On an event with 518,669 sent-email rows the export worker ran out of memory building xlsx and the task stayed stuck "In Progress"; the table also lacked an event_id index.
ai.wy: Large events could not export their sent-email data.
ai.oc: An index on global_email_sent (event_id, created) and CSV streaming above about 50,000 rows, keeping xlsx for small exports.

summary: [TechDept] [BE + QA!]Stuck cron_tasks rows: unified reaper with attempts counter and Failed state

ai.s: Adds a unified reaper for stuck cron tasks, with an attempts counter and a Failed state, so admin jobs no longer show "In Progress" forever.
ai.pr: When a cron_tasks handler was killed its row stayed active forever; the partial reaper waited up to 12 hours, retried endlessly and overwrote timestamps (EP-52278 blocked exports for half a day).
ai.wy: Tech debt that blocks users and destroys the audit trail.
ai.oc: New attempts and last_reaped_at columns, a partial index and a reapStaleCronTasks step on every tick with per-family timeouts.

ai.pr: Not clearly specified in the ticket; the description links to a Confluence page and gives a rough 21-day estimate. Media loading presumably caused layout shifts.
ai.wy: Reported by IMEX; part of Platform Performance & Operational Efficiency 2026.
ai.oc: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; automatic media space reservation per breakpoint is expected.

summary: reCAPTCHA timeout during registration - improve UX and token refresh mechanism

ai.s: Keeps reCAPTCHA valid during long registration forms with silent token refresh and a clear message if it does expire.
ai.pr: reCAPTCHA v2 tokens expire after 2 minutes, so users who took longer to fill in registration could not submit, as EP-52402 showed.
ai.wy: Users were failing to complete registration; the earlier bug was closed without fixing the cause.
ai.oc: Automatic token refresh before expiry, an actionable expiry message and an evaluation of moving to reCAPTCHA v3.
